## Code

### P9 "pitchShifter" (Faust) · Text

```faust
declare name 		"pitchShifter";
declare version 	"1.0";
declare author 		"Grame";
declare license 	"BSD";
declare copyright 	"(c)GRAME 2006";

 //--------------------------------------
 // Very simple real time pitch shifter
 //--------------------------------------
 
import("stdfaust.lib");

pitchshifter = vgroup("Pitch Shifter", ef.transpose(
									hslider("window (samples)", 1000, 50, 10000, 1),
									hslider("xfade (samples)", 10, 1, 10000, 1),
									hslider("shift (semitones) ", 0, -24, +24, 0.1)
								  )
				);

process = pitchshifter;
```

### P14 "Limiter" (Faust) · Text

```faust
declare name "Limiter";
declare author "Yann Orlarey";

/* ========= DESCRITPION ==========

- A limiter is a security that prevents a sound from saturating

*/

process =slimiter;

slimiter(x,y) =x*coeff,y*coeff

	with {
		epsilon =1/(44100*1.0);
		peak = max(abs(x),abs(y)):max~-(epsilon);
		coeff = 1.0/max(1.0,peak);
    };
```
